SF.

What is currently being worked on:

1. Finishing the flywheel (our flywheel was built out around a week ago but never fully integrated yet)

60% of all platform fees will be redirected to $STONK buybacks, with a revenue page and dashboard to track it publicly.

2. Integrate rewards instead of creator fees

Creators will have the option to distribute their creator fee share to holders, we will work on making a option for existing coins to switch to reward coins.

All coins will be backed by @xStocksFi pairs as they currently are.

Furthermore, talking with platforms such as GMGN, Terminal and Fomo.

You can currently trade directly on @AxiomExchange, @fomo @JupiterExchange @Raydium 

We have been constantly active in our telegram if you wish to chat, ask questions or discuss any concerns.

Some peoples concerns answered:

1. We are the first platform for tokenized stock pairs on solana, we had social profile issues which caused the platform to lose attention, which are resolved.

2. We were active in the TG, people were complaining on other competitors that came around and took our share, which we now are the leading tokenized stocks launchpad on solana, the only launchpad that actually pairs coins with stocks.

We originally contacted Axiom and got into a group with the team a week ago, and pushed for adding xStocks pairs, which are now finally integrated.

3. Axiom integrated xStocks which solved majority of the issues around attention, Stonk was only tradeable via Jupiter before and many users don't export their wallets which limited the volume and visibility.

We are working with other platforms to also integrate it, which they will likely follow.

4. The site, platform, and tg were operational the whole time, we never took down anything and were waiting for terminal integrations to push our next updates, as we did not have mindshare quite yet on the platform, as we were waiting for over a week.

5. Solana does the largest volume of tokenized equities outside of BNB.

$STONK is the platform token, and the very first stock paired coin on solana.

We will answer any concerns, or questions and keep building.

20% of xstocks volume today is STONK and tokens launched on stonkfun.

LP concerns:

Let me explain how the tech works;

You launch via Raydium CLMM which creates two onesided LP positions, Both are locked, the fee NFT is transferred to the platform for the platforms share, the fee position is transferred to the creator for the creators share. These LP Nft's are just for the fees, they don't represent the ability to pull LP

All liquidity is locked automatically on launches of tokens

Example flow of a launch is here
https://t.co/UUEa6pzMXD

One more misconception of how Raydium fees work:

On axiom some users are seeing "remove LP" in small amounts, this is just how Raydium LP fees work. Fees are automatically claimed and accrued.

There is no liquidity being removed as liquidity is locked on all pairs forever.

- New unique features, UI updates, and supporting projects launching on the platform/ecosystem.

Introducing our new fee mechanism:

- 2x increased platform revenue & $STONK buybacks
- Improved efficiency
- No more supply drag on new reward tokens
- No change in the total fee (4% rewards, 1% no rewards)

All new launches on the platform will have fees claimed only in the quote token, on the rewards side & platform side.

Base means the token being traded ($STONK), quote meaning the token you are trading against ($SPYX)

On our V1 of rewards/fee coins fees were claimed in the base + quote pair, and half the rewards came from base token supply.

Without claiming the base token and burning it from platform fees, the platforms share is now the full amount allocated.

Rewards no longer have to come from any of the base token

Our next update is being worked on and will be pushed soon so that small holders are getting rewarded properly for coins at higher market caps.

Our user docs will be out soon explaining how the mechanics of rewards work, market cap based reward pool thresholds, distribution thresholds, holding minimums.

Alongside the next update for reward distributions which will be able to distribute to smaller holders, we are working on a update to solve for liquidity being spread across multiple pools as tokens grow since the main Raydium CLMM pools for reward tokens are 4% fees.

More information soon on solving for this, which will further retain rewards, platform revenue & $STONK buybacks on higher cap coins.

Quick update:

Rewards: 

Handling so that small holders can get distributions properly at higher market caps, and that rewards don't just go only to larger holders on high caps.

Fees:

Working on solving for pools being undercut at higher market caps from Meteora pools (users are creating 2% pools on Meteora and LPing to undercut the 4% pool) which we are solving for shortly. 

Increases rewards overall, increases revenue for the platform + $STONK.

Snipers:

Working on where users will be able to execute dev buys, and other unique ways to handle sniping of new pairs without limiting the ability for people to quickly trade new pairs.

V1 Pairs: 

Creating a mechanism where OG coins that were under V1 fees (quote + base) will stop having supply pressure and distribute in both quote + base.

Note: V1 pairs means pairs that were created a few days ago before our changes to quote only fees.

Which will no longer have supply pressure. Majority of all the new pairs are quote only fees such as Butthole, which don't have any supply pressure for rewards by base token swaps.

These will be switched on V1.

< $50k- $50
$50k – $100k - $200

$50M +  $50,000 pot cap

If you have any requests, they will be forwarded to the Sunrise team.

Updates:

1. Working on migrating to LaunchLab, this would solve for snipers on new pairs, increase volume, and incentivize more deployers. It would mean cheaper deploys, fully permissionless and traditional bonding curves which people are used to. 

This would overall help to increase volume across new token deployments. While benefiting $STONK and our ecosystem from the ecosystem flywheel.

2. We are looking into ways to handle distributions on-chain, which would reduce centralization risks, such as through a Merkle Distributor.

3. Working on UI improvements to the site overall and mobile.

4. New listings are coming, been working with Sunrise directly to get new assets listed. Such as $LLY coming tmr

5. Solving for further improvements around Standard tokens to incentivize deployments outside of just rewards.

We believe StonkFun has brought something truly unique to Solana, coins paired with anything. 
We are the only platform that offers it, and it is very difficult for other platforms to compete.

StonkFun also handled the integration into terminals for custom quotes, routing and more.

Memecoins / Paired with anything.

Note: Migrating to LaunchLab would mean custom quotes such as RWA's, memes and more on bonding curves.

This would solve for issues around one-sided pools, operator wallet centralization, incentivize more deployments, increased volume and more.

We have been working directly with Raydium and LaunchLab has integrated custom quote assets for us to complete this migration.

Addressing any concerns around other platforms:

1. It is very difficult to support any custom quote token when other platforms are using market cap based dynamic fees, you have to handle for endless quote assets and price them accordingly. We do not use market cap based dynamic fees.

2. Collecting revenue across possibly thousands of quote tokens is very difficult.

3. Integrating custom quotes into current bonding curve programs is difficult, handling for it is very difficult if you are doing more then a few quote tokens. It would require rebuilding what has been built over years. 

4. StonkFun has a large userbase and moat that has grown organically, with a lot of supporters behind us.

Rewards update.

The StonkFun rewards pipeline has been upgraded.

Rewards no longer wait for a large pot to accumulate before harvesting transfer tax. Fees are converted and distributed continuously.

The upgrade allows for separate horizontal scaling at each stage. There are also distinct thresholds for each stage:

• Harvesting
• Claiming & swapping
• Planning and funding distributions
• Sending distributions to holders

If a conversion ever lags behind volume, rewards can be distributed in the coin itself so payouts keep flowing without delay or excessive harvesting.

Live for new and existing coins launched on LaunchLab, with the upgrade rolling out to legacy coins (CLMM) soon.

The pipeline is still being tuned for optimal performance, further concurrency and prioritization algorithms are being worked on.

parents_of_account_replies.text:
If you are new to $STONK

Here is probably the easiest way to understand the entire ecosystem from zero:

STONK is basically a meme token on Solana built around the StonkFun ecosystem.

The easiest way to think about it is:

$STONK = the token
StonkFun = the launchpad/system around it

StonkFun basically combines two of the biggest speculative narratives:

Pre-IPO stocks + memecoins.

Instead of being just another isolated meme

The idea is to create an entire launch and discovery system around these assets.

The flow is basically:

- A token launches through StonkFun.
- StonkFun identifies it as part of the ecosystem.

And users can then discover and trade these assets through a more social trading experience.

StonkFun has already been integrated into Fomo App.

Meaning users can see whether a token was originally launched through StonkFun.

But there is another integration coming that makes the system much more interesting:

Launchlab.

The upcoming Launchlab integration is expected to change deployments

Add bonding curves
And improve the entire launch experience.

Now let’s understand bonding curves.

A bonding curve basically makes the token price increase as more demand enters.

More people buy
The token moves further along the curve

And the price increases.

This makes it much easier to launch and discover the price of completely new tokens.

And also heavily rewards being early.

So the entire system starts looking like this:

StonkFun launches the asset
Bonding curves create the initial price discovery

Now we get to $STONK itself.

And the token has been one of the strongest performers recently.

Over the last 30 days

STONK went from:

$0.00723

To:

$0.17897

With approximately: $225.6M in cumulative DEX volume.

So there is clearly real trading activity around the token.

So if you want to follow $STONK

There are basically three things I would watch:

- StonkFun adoption
- Fomo + Launchlab integrations
- DEX volume and large holder movements

Because if StonkFun keeps attracting launches

And the pre-IPO stock narrative keeps growing

STONK could become one of the most interesting speculative ecosystems on Solana.

@LaunchOnSF Hello STONK team,

As someone who actively follows STONK Market, I wanted to share some feedback that I believe could help improve the platform.

While analyzing the market, I’ve noticed occasional freezing in real-time coin data, delays, and inconsistencies between different chart timeframes. When millions of dollars in volume are moving through the STONK market, accurate and responsive charts are extremely important for users making decisions based on this data.

For example, with the SUPERINU coin, I noticed that the ATH appears to be around 4M on the 30-minute chart, while the 1-hour chart shows it around 2M. Differences like this between timeframes can make market analysis confusing and potentially lead users to make incorrect decisions.

I’m sharing this feedback because I genuinely support STONK and would love to see the platform become even more accurate, responsive, and reliable. I believe improving real-time data synchronization and chart accuracy would make a meaningful difference.
